###

###  
###

###

## About Us

Thermoplastic Hot Melt Films Combine High-tech
Properties and Versatility

TPU bridges the gap between hard thermoplastics and rubber. It can be deformed under tensile load
and reformed to its original shape afterward. Thanks to its molecular structure, TPU can be
stretched when heated, melted, and molded. These soft and elastic films enable uncomplicated fabric
lamination, light management, weight saving, and volume minimization. Our portfolio of products
includes a variety of [Hot Melt Adhesive Film][68] & [Hot Melt Adhesive Web][69] and seamless
garments machines, heat press machines, and ultrasonic machines, which are All-in-one fabric bonding
solutions. Alster is a professional adhesive film manufacturer and supplier. 

## Our Product Range

### [Hot Melt Adhesive Film][70]

Alster’s Hot Melt Adhesive Film provides an efficient and reliable solution for a wide series of
bonding applications. Designed to activate with heat, this adhesive film delivers a clean, strong
bond across various materials, including textiles, plastics, and metals. Its solvent-free
formulation not only makes it environmentally friendly but also ensures a smooth application
process.

### [Hot Melt Adhesive Web][71]

Alster’s Hot Melt Adhesive Web is a specialized bonding material that combines flexibility and
breathability. Its non-woven, web-like structure allows for excellent airflow and moisture
management, making it particularly suitable for applications in garments, footwear, and textiles.
Activated by heat, this adhesive web ensures a lightweight yet secure bond.

### [Pur Glue][72]

Alster’s Polyurethane Reactive (PUR) Glue is a versatile adhesive known for its exceptional bonding
strength and durability. Unlike conventional adhesives, PUR Glue reacts with moisture to form a
flexible, long-lasting bond that withstands temperature fluctuations and environmental stress.

### [Bonding Machine][73]

Alster’s Bonding Machine is an essential tool for precise and efficient adhesive application in
manufacturing processes. Designed to work with hot melt films, webs, and PUR glues, this machine
applies the necessary heat and pressure to ensure a consistent and strong bond. Widely used in
industries such as electronics, textiles, and automotive manufacturing.

نشریه علمی پژوهشی مواد پیشرفته و پوشش­ های نوین (AMNC) یکی از چهار نشریه ­ای است که توسط انجمن علمی
رنگ ایران بصورت فصلنامه با هدف انتشار جدیدترین دستاوردهای علمی محققین کشور در کلیه زمینه های مرتبط
با علم مواد شامل نانوفناوری، شیمی، فیزیک، پلیمر و مهندسی پزشکی منتشر می شود.

این نشریه مورد تایید وزارت علوم، تحقیقات و فناوری جمهوری اسلامی ایران بوده و از جمله نشریات شاخص در
حوزه تخصصی علم مواد محسوب می شود.

 

**محورهای اصلی پذیرش مقالات جهت داوری در این نشریه عبارتند از**:

نانومواد پیشرفته، رزینها و پلیمرها، مهندسی سطح و پوششها، خوردگی و الکتروشیمی، رنگدانه ها و مواد
رنگزا، نانوکامپوزیتها، مواد معدنی و سرامیکها، رنگ سنجی و فیزیک نور، ابعاد بصری رنگ، مواد نیمه رسانا،
کریستالهای مایع، حسگرهای پزشکی و مواد پیشرفته  برای کاربردهای انرژی و محیط زیست و شیمی محاسباتی.

 

**از محققین گرامی خواهشمند است پیش از ارسال مقالات، بخشهای [اصول اخلاقی انتشار مقا][39]له و [راهنمای
نگارش مقا][40]له را به دقت مطالعه فرمایند. لازم به ذکر است که این نشریه از قوانین کمیته بین المللی
اخلاق در نشر ([COPE][41]) پیروی کرده و کلیه نویسندگان و افراد فعال در نشریه (سردبیر نشریه، اعضای هیأت
تحریریه، دبیر تخصصی، ویراستار و ناشر) می بایست به قوانین و اصول اخلاقی مذکور پایبند باشند.  قایل ذکر
است این نشریه عضو COPE نیست اما از قوانین آن پیروی می کند. **

****فرم تعارض منافع نویسندگان نیز در بخش راهنمای نویسندگان آورده شده است. ****

رنگزا، نانوکامپوزیتها، مواد معدنی و سرامیکها، رنگ سنجی و فیزیک نور، ابعاد بصری رنگ، مواد نیمه رسانا،
کریستالهای مایع، حسگرهای پزشکی و مواد پیشرفته  برای کاربردهای انرژی و محیط زیست و شیمی محاسباتی.

 

**از محققین گرامی خواهشمند است پیش از ارسال مقالات، بخشهای [اصول اخلاقی انتشار مقا][39]له و [راهنمای
نگارش مقا][40]له را به دقت مطالعه فرمایند. لازم به ذکر است که این نشریه از قوانین کمیته بین المللی
اخلاق در نشر ([COPE][41]) پیروی کرده و کلیه نویسندگان و افراد فعال در نشریه (سردبیر نشریه، اعضای هیأت
تحریریه، دبیر تخصصی، ویراستار و ناشر) می بایست به قوانین و اصول اخلاقی مذکور پایبند باشند.  قایل ذکر
است این نشریه عضو COPE نیست اما از قوانین آن پیروی می کند. **

****فرم تعارض منافع نویسندگان نیز در بخش راهنمای نویسندگان آورده شده است. ****

 

****اطلاعات نشریه "مواد پیشرفته و پوشش های نوین" در یک نگاه**:**
* ****نوع اعتبار: علمی-پژوهشی (وزارت علوم، تحقیقات و فناوری)
  ****
* ********ناشر: انجمن علمی رنگ ایران
  ********
* ****توالی انتشار: فصلنامه****
* ****نوع داوری: دوسو ناشناس****
* ****میانگین فاصله زمانی ارسال مقاله تا دریافت اولین بازنگری: 40 روز****
* ********زبان نشریه: چکیده (فارسی و انگلیسی) + مقاله (فارسی)
  ********
* ********نوع انتشار: الکترونیکی********
* ********نوع دسترسی: رایگان (تمام متن)********
* ********هزینه بررسی و انتشار: دارد (ارزیابی اولیه: 500.000  ریال - در صورت پذیرش نهایی: 1.500.000
  ریال)
  ********

**^{** }نشریه مواد پیشرفته و پوشش های نوین در زمره نشریات اصلی پایگاه استنادی علوم جهان اسلام (ISC)
قرار دارد ^{**}
**

 

** مقالات پر بازدید**
[ مروری بر هیدروژل ها، خواص و کاربرد آنها در پزشکی][42]
[ پایداری گرمایی و تخریب گرمایی نانو کامپوزیت های اپوکسی در حضور نانو ذرات الاستومری شبکه ای شده][43]
[ بررسی الکتروشیمیایی تشکیل لایه SEI در فرایند فرماسیون آند گرافیت طبیعی در باتری لیتیوم- یون][44]
[ بررسی فرآیند دینامیک جذب سطحی پروتئین موسین در فصل مشترک آب و هوا][45]
[ شبیه سازی خواص مکانیکی بافت های بدن با استفاده از هیدروژل های الاستومری بر پایه پلی یورتان با
قابلیت چاپ سه بعدی][46]
[ بررسی خصوصیات و کاربردهای کامپوزیت های چارچوب فلزی-آلی مغناطیسی (MMOF) جهت آشکارسازی و حذف آلاینده
های زیست محیطی][47]
[ ساخت نانوبیوسنسور گاز اتانول بر پایه کامپوزیت GO/PANI/SnO2][48]

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

## The High-Performance Acetal Resin

Leading companies across the globe specify Delrin® acetal homopolymer for high-load mechanical
applications such as gears, safety restraints, door systems, conveyor belts, healthcare delivery
devices, and other demanding products and parts. Delrin® acetal homopolymer (Polyoxymethylene POM)
is the ideal material in parts designed to replace metal. It combines low-friction and high-wear
resistance with the high strength and stiffness such applications require. It provides a wide
operating temperature range (-40 °C to 90 °C) and good colorability. Delrin® also mates well with
metals and other polymers and offers excellent dimensional stability in high precision molding.

## The High-Performance Acetal Resin

Leading companies across the globe specify Delrin® acetal homopolymer for high-load mechanical
applications such as gears, safety restraints, door systems, conveyor belts, healthcare delivery
devices, and other demanding products and parts. Delrin® acetal homopolymer (Polyoxymethylene POM)
is the ideal material in parts designed to replace metal. It combines low-friction and high-wear
resistance with the high strength and stiffness such applications require. It provides a wide
operating temperature range (-40 °C to 90 °C) and good colorability. Delrin® also mates well with
metals and other polymers and offers excellent dimensional stability in high precision molding.

# Doupu - A Globally Trusted Provider of Turnkey Engineering Solutions

Doupu  is advancing unceasingly in the biotechnology field with a global vision, advanced
technologies, and premium services. We look forward to joining hands with more customers to jointly
propel the juice beverage production, plant extraction, coffee, and dairy product processing
industries to new heights.
Doupu . has won the favor of global customers with its cutting - edge technology and high - quality
products. Since its establishment, we have been committed to providing innovative solutions for the
juice beverage production, plant extraction, and dairy product processing industries. In particular,
we have achieved remarkable results in the research and manufacturing of various separation
equipment, such as centrifuges, membrane filtration, and membrane concentration devices.

Our machines, renowned for their outstanding performance and stable quality, have been sold to
numerous countries worldwide. From the prosperous markets in Europe and the Americas to the rapidly
developing regions in Asia, Africa, and South America, our equipment operates efficiently. Both top
- tier research institutions in developed countries and emerging enterprises in developing countries
have highly praised our products. These devices play a crucial role in enhancing production
efficiency and optimizing product quality for customers around the globe, contributing significantly
to every link of the juice beverage production, plant extraction, and dairy product processing
industrial chains.
* Cooperation Cases
  With its core advantages of high efficiency, energy conservation, and environmental friendliness,
  membrane separation technology has built a bridge of technical empowerment across multiple fields
  such as water treatment, complete juice beverage production lines, complete milk production lines,
  and plant extraction. Whether it is the precise purification in basic water treatment, the quality
  upgrading in the food and beverage industry (such as retaining the flavor of fruit juices and
  protecting active ingredients in milk), or the efficient purification in plant extraction, its
  modular design and customized solutions can adapt to the needs of different scenarios. By
  simplifying processes, reducing energy consumption, and improving purity, it has become a common
  choice for all industries to enhance quality, reduce costs, and cut emissions, profoundly
  demonstrating the overall driving force of technological innovation for industrial upgrading.

Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

space to manufacture on time and on budget.

## FAQ

## Ask Us
## Anything

How do you ensure the dimensional stability of PEEK shapes during high-precision machining?

This is our core strength. All Jekin materials undergo a proprietary **Multi-stage Stress-Relief
(Annealing) process**. Unlike common market shapes, our rods and plates are “relaxed” from the
inside out, meaning zero cracking and zero warping, even for complex CNC parts with tight
tolerances.

Do you use 100% virgin resin, and can you provide traceability?

Absolutely. We exclusively use **100% virgin granules** from industry leaders. Each batch comes with
a Certificate of Analysis (COA) and full traceability. For semiconductor or medical applications,
this ensures zero contamination and consistent mechanical properties.

As a manufacturer, how do you guarantee lead times for custom or large orders?

With our **newly established production facility in Jiangsu (2025)**, we have significantly expanded
our extrusion capacity. For standard stock, we ship within 48 hours. For custom sizes or specialized
grades, our lead times are typically 30-50% faster than major international brands because we
control the entire production line.

Can I request a small sample block for a machining test before placing a bulk order?

We encourage it! We believe our material speaks for itself. We provide **complimentary machining
sample blocks** so you can test the feed rates and surface finish on your own machines. This
eliminates your risk and ensures the material is perfect for your specific application.

Do you offer "Cut-to-Size" services, and how can it save me money?

Yes, we offer precision sawing and cutting. Instead of buying a full 3-meter rod, you can order the
exact lengths you need. This reduces your **material scrap costs** and saves your team’s time in
preparation, allowing you to focus purely on the final CNC precision work.

## FAQ

## Ask Us
## Anything

How do you ensure the dimensional stability of PEEK shapes during high-precision machining?

This is our core strength. All Jekin materials undergo a proprietary **Multi-stage Stress-Relief
(Annealing) process**. Unlike common market shapes, our rods and plates are “relaxed” from the
inside out, meaning zero cracking and zero warping, even for complex CNC parts with tight
tolerances.

Do you use 100% virgin resin, and can you provide traceability?

Absolutely. We exclusively use **100% virgin granules** from industry leaders. Each batch comes with
a Certificate of Analysis (COA) and full traceability. For semiconductor or medical applications,
this ensures zero contamination and consistent mechanical properties.

As a manufacturer, how do you guarantee lead times for custom or large orders?

With our **newly established production facility in Jiangsu (2025)**, we have significantly expanded
our extrusion capacity. For standard stock, we ship within 48 hours. For custom sizes or specialized
grades, our lead times are typically 30-50% faster than major international brands because we
control the entire production line.

Can I request a small sample block for a machining test before placing a bulk order?

We encourage it! We believe our material speaks for itself. We provide **complimentary machining
sample blocks** so you can test the feed rates and surface finish on your own machines. This
eliminates your risk and ensures the material is perfect for your specific application.

Do you offer "Cut-to-Size" services, and how can it save me money?

Yes, we offer precision sawing and cutting. Instead of buying a full 3-meter rod, you can order the
exact lengths you need. This reduces your **material scrap costs** and saves your team’s time in
preparation, allowing you to focus purely on the final CNC precision work.

and accessories for mixing various plastic materials such as PVC, PE, PP, ABS, as well as technical
and special polymers such as TPE, PA, PC, PU, PET, PTFE, among others. In addition, PLAS MEC deals
with resins for powder coatings, wood-plastic composites, masterbatches, additives, pigments and
thermoplastic rubber.

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

and efficiency.

**CÔNG TY TNHH CÔNG NGHỆ Y TẾ TAKENKO** được thành lập vào ngày 04 tháng 06 năm 2009 là Công ty cổ
phần với mạng lưới hoạt động trên khắp mọi miền đất nước, chuyên cung phân phối và cung ứng các loại
